designs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: netKonnect evolving upload/download transport routes, concept art presentation sheet, preview only.
Primary request: A beautiful detailed watercolor-and-navy-ink illustrated design sheet showing eight stages of evolving transport infrastructure for a cozy city growth network visualization. Existing vehicles are STATIC TWO-DIMENSIONAL SIDE-PROFILE sprites: the infrastructure MUST accommodate side-profile vehicles traveling horizontally left/right without rotation, perspective deformation, scaling into depth, or turns. Solve this by shallow elevated SIDE-ON landscape theatre view with horizontal transport strips stacked as terraces, visible narrow top surfaces and textured front edges. NOT isometric.
Style: Hand-painted watercolor on warm ivory paper, fine dark navy pen outlines, sage greenery, terracotta roofs, pale ivory masonry, soft blue sky and glass; sophisticated illustrated European landscape, restrained charming details, matches a watercolor town panorama. No 3D game rendering.
Composition: Large landscape design sheet, tidy TWO COLUMNS x FOUR ROWS of eight sufficiently wide miniature landscape panels. Clear gutters. One short numbered panel title above each. Each panel features TWO visually separate left-to-right HORIZONTAL parallel corridors: farther upper lane DOWNLOAD heading RIGHT toward the city at right; nearer lower lane UPLOAD heading LEFT away from the city. Small blue right arrow and "DOWNLOAD" above upper corridor, small warm terracotta left arrow and "UPLOAD" below lower corridor. Both lanes have their own straight uninterrupted sprite baseline, gentle natural roadside contours only OUTSIDE that baseline. Each panel includes 1 or 2 small perfectly side-profile vehicles, with circular wheels exactly grounded on the lane baseline. Keep vehicles smaller than the infrastructure.
Panels in exact reading order:
"01 · DIRT": two narrow ochre earth paths, wagon ruts, grass edges, wildflowers, tiny timber shack to right, side-profile handcart heading right and a small wheelbarrow heading left.
"02 · GRAVEL": two compacted crushed-stone tracks, scattered pebbles only on verges, timber culvert, cabin clearing, side-profile cargo bicycle and tricycle.
"03 · SINGLE LANE": one paved carriageway PER direction, unmarked asphalt, gravel shoulders, modest house and hedge, side-profile microvan/pickup.
"04 · BOULEVARD": two separate broad paved carriageways with dashed lane markings, stone curbs, planted median between upload/download terraces, elegant lamps and town roofline, flat side-profile van and truck.
"05 · SMALL HIGHWAY": two straight carriageways with two lanes each rendered as shallow parallel bands, guardrails positioned BELOW vehicle body silhouettes, distant town and small exit signage only at panel end, side-profile box truck and lorry.
"06 · LARGE HIGHWAY": two wider divided carriageways, three shallow lanes each, landscaped median, distant metropolitan skyline, a small overhead sign at extreme right, profile semi trucks; avoid overpasses hiding the moving vehicles.
"07 · WATERWAYS": two straight blue navigable channel strips representing both directions, low stone banks and dock at right, profile barge heading right and freighter heading left, waterline intersects bottom of hull correctly; retain a slim road terrace behind as accumulated infrastructure.
"08 · AIRPORT": two horizontal AIR CORRIDORS overhead with side-profile cargo aircraft facing opposite directions, airport terminal and straight runway strips below, runway edge lights, near-horizontal dotted approach guides, mature city at right; retain smaller road and canal terraces below. Planes in flight are side profile, no diagonal banking.
Typography: Small neat navy editorial sans-serif titles, clear readable concise labels only as specified; main heading "ROUTES THAT GROW WITH THE CITY". Tiny subtitle "Horizontal paths · Side-profile fleet".
Constraints: consistent orthographic side profile sprite-compatible viewpoint across ALL panels; no roads converging into horizon, no diagonals, no S curves, no circular loops, no forced perspective, no three-quarter vehicles, no vertical arrow icons implying vehicles travel vertically. Infrastructure progression is the star. Daylight, polished purposeful concept art, no app chrome or metrics, no watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: detailed netKonnect transport-system design concept, landscape panorama preview.
Primary request: Show a mature city with beautifully evolving, layered Upload and Download transport infrastructure compatible with existing STATIC 2D true SIDE-PROFILE vehicle sprites. Create one polished wide watercolor/ink illustration of a complete multimodal transport landscape, not a contact sheet. Roads and transport corridors are foreground heroes and must read at small UI scale.
Style/medium: Match sophisticated hand-painted watercolor on ivory paper, fine navy ink contours, sage and olive greenery, terracotta roofs, ivory town architecture, soft blue glass/sky, textured understated natural materials. Existing game backgrounds are broad illustrated European town landscapes, fleet is broadside watercolor trucks. This image is a concept proposal, not a 3D render.
Composition/framing: Wide 2:1 landscape image. Fixed straight-on elevated SIDE ELEVATION with shallow visible TOP SURFACES of roads, landscape-theatre terracing. All active transport routes run perfectly HORIZONTALLY across frame from left toward a CITY/LOGISTICS HUB at far right, NO route recedes into depth. Mountains, clouds, and distant town skyline occupy upper background. Urban/port/airport buildings are gathered mostly in rightmost quarter and behind the routes, leaving long clear travel space. Sprite sizes remain CONSTANT across x.
Organize THREE readable transport bands stacked vertically with ample breathing room:
1. AIR at upper sky: a blue cargo plane true broadside nose pointing RIGHT on a thin pale blue dotted horizontal DOWNLOAD guide; a terracotta cargo plane true broadside nose pointing LEFT on a separate thin warm dotted UPLOAD guide lower in sky. Airport terminal and control tower at far right below planes, with horizontal airstrip in its local area. Planes are level, wings minimal visible broadside, no banking.
2. ROAD in middle foreground: two separate parallel carriageways, upper DOWNLOAD road with right-facing ivory/blue loaded trucks, lower UPLOAD road with left-facing sage/terracotta trucks. Wide gray watercolor tarmac strips with shallow parallel lane markings, pale stone curbs, low guardrails, grassy median and occasional low hedges. Exactly two trucks on download, two trucks on upload, well separated. Vehicles in STRICT true side profile, wheels circular on level road baselines, no 3/4 view. Low streetlamp fixtures behind road, greenery outside moving sprite paths. Far right cargo depot with parking apron and warehouse doors, where trucks can visually arrive.
3. WATER at bottom: two separated horizontal strips of a navigable canal, with upper right-facing loaded blue barge and lower left-facing warm freighter. Low stone banks and a dock/quayside crane at far right. The ship hulls align naturally to waterline. A narrow road connector along back bank implies roads remain when shipping unlocks. DO NOT place ships on tarmac or trucks on water.
Directional language: Tiny navy editorial header "THE CITY TRANSPORT TERRACES". Blue marks/signs for Download direction RIGHT and warm terracotta marks/signs for Upload direction LEFT, NEVER painting whole roads bright colors. Add precisely six discreet gutter labels, one near left endpoint of each horizontal travel corridor, reading "DOWNLOAD →" and "← UPLOAD", one pair per transport band. No other labels or invented lettering, slogans, brands, statistics, billboards, speed numbers or UI panels.
Practical game layering: keep all guardrails below wheel/hull silhouettes; do not obscure sprites with trees, street furniture or cranes in mid-route. Illustrated soft contact shadows under trucks, subtle wake behind ships, no motion blur. Grounded road baselines, shared light direction, readable silhouettes, parallel orthographic movement tracks. Painterly detail on terrain and stationary props, calm uncluttered corridors.
Avoid: isometric perspective, converging lanes, diagonals, curved route paths, bends, roundabouts, road overpasses, vehicle rotation, foreshortening, scaling vehicles into depth, giant aircraft filling sky, aggressive UI neon, geometric vector art, photorealism, watermarks.
designs.repairPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied City Transport Terraces concept illustration. Make exactly one small correction: the blue container truck on the UPPER DOWNLOAD ROAD near the center-right (the one currently with its cab on its LEFT end) must face RIGHT, matching the blue truck on its left and the DOWNLOAD → sign. Reverse the cab/container arrangement of that one truck so its ivory cab is on its RIGHT end and its blue cargo container behind to the left. Retain its exact location, scale, true side profile, circular grounded wheels, painted texture, and lighting. Keep EVERY OTHER ELEMENT unchanged: all other vehicles and their orientations, road geometry, buildings, river, ships, aircraft, labels, foliage, framing and colors. Do not change the upload road trucks. No new objects or text.
